correctness.rationale: For p>=3, replace exactly two columns of the unitarily normalized plus-quarter-shift Fourier basis with orthonormal minus-quarter columns. A two-dimensional unitary compression K controls the complete smallest Gram eigenvalue, 1-sqrt(1-s_min(K)^2). Direct geometric-sum and phase identities reduce K, up to two diagonal unitaries, to [[d,b],[-c,d]], giving the claimed closed singular-value expression. The strict adjacency inequality is equivalent to positivity of a quadratic with negative discriminant; strict period monotonicity follows by factoring the period parameter. Entire proof valid for every p>=3, all separations; checker executed successfully with 909 finite assertions, not treated as infinite proof.
